ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels to 40% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features a large contiguous white area with black borders. A central black triangular mass extends from the peduncle base to the median notch. Right lobe exhibits a white field with black streaking along the trailing edge and distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an internal angle of approximately 95 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks most prominent on the distal margins of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along leading edges; concave sweep along trailing edges from lobe tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters visible in the lower central white zone of the left lobe and at the far-left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several near-vertical black linear disruptions present on the white surface of the right lobe, extending from the trailing edge inward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe shows significant structural irregularity and dark, textured scarring/protrusion relative to the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific 'feathered' pigmentation pattern where black pixels transition into the white field via fine vertical streaks on the medial-right lobe.
